parameters.jsCode:
const s = v => typeof v === 'string' ? v : JSON.stringify(v); const rows = []; for (const it of $input.all()) { const ks = it.json.keys; if (!Array.isArray(ks)) throw new Error('no keys: ' + JSON.stringify(it.json).slice(0,300)); for (const k of ks) { const nm = typeof k.key_name === 'object' ? (k.key_name.web || k.key_name.other) : k.key_name; const t = {}; for (const tr of (k.translations||[])) { const v = s(tr.translation); if (v) t[tr.language_iso] = v; } rows.push({ k: nm, t }); } }
return [{ json: { meta: $('Pick').first().json.total + ' keys scanned, ' + $('Pick').first().json.nHits + ' hits', n: rows.length, rows } }];
